What is her hold on the people of Morton Fendle, a village still overshadowed by the gloomy spectre of the war?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Faith Alexander arrives in Midsomer Deverell to meet her long-lost uncle Rex Masters, she is surprised to find that he has disappeared and that he had told everyone that she was killed in a plane crash. Then Rex's body is found in the weir, and his friends produce wills, each claiming to inherit his fortune, but what is the truth about Rex's life of mischief-making, and who wanted him dead?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. Is the killer trying to prevent James from marrying beautiful divorcee Delyth Mostyn? How is the death linked to the £30,000 which is missing from the surgery account?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. To make matters worse, it appears that Barnaby visited the victim on the night he died, and a glass with his fingerprints on it is found at the dead man's home. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of 'The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: When an old colleague of DCI Barnaby's is found murdered, a sex scandal at Causton police station 16 years previously comes back to haunt him. His investigation takes him to Midsomer Holm, a halfway house for ex-prisoners founded by Lord Holm, a man who also served time for the murder of his wife. As they try to find links between the suspects and a seedy group known as the Friday Nighters, another person goes missing.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hodgson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the 'beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tearooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: A burglar known as 'the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: Midsomer Murders
programme.desc: The crime drama returns for a new series. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

Realizing that Fong's days are numbered, Chou hires two new experts to deal with him and his sixty-second technique, but to no avail. The Ghost Faced Killer, meanwhile is hunting down a number of clan leaders who all conspired to have him killed. Before attacking, the killer always throws down his "ghost face killing plate," a decorated metal plate with a red face. He then uses his distinctive five elements style.

Wa Chi Keung is a peasant who escaped the mass murder of his village by the Japanese. He joins his master in Beijing shortly before the old man's assassination by ninjas. What follows is a one man war on the Ninjas and Japan top bushido experts.

As one of the earliest black belts of icon Ed Parker, Sullivan stepped into history in 1961 by developing the first series of instructional films which played a key role in the early stages of promoting kenpo throughout the world.

programme.title: Magnificent Chivalry
programme.desc: Hong Kong superstar Jimmy "One Arm Boxer" Wang Yu stars as the Bamboo blade, China's top swordsman. His services are rendered by the Imperial treasury, who wants him to infiltrate a powerful gang of Highwaymen and get back the stolen silver bullion. After numerous deadly encounters the gang is beaten by the bamboo sword and only the gang leader remains; however he's a lot tougher than they originally bargained for.

programme.title: Secret of Chinese Kung Fu

Chang Chi rises to the top at the cannery and becomes foreman. Chang Chi's promotion is short-lived as the thug, Kang Ho (Lo Lieh), strong arms the cannery ownership from old man Cheng and bounces Chang Chi back to a regular worker. So why does Kang Ho want this fish cannery?

programme.title: Dragon's Snake Fist

Will Snake Fist Lee vanquish the deadly Golden Needles of his arch-enemy Ho and bring honor to his clan? A duel to the death is the only inevitability!

One day, a proud man dares to step forth and speak against Yen Chan Ying's villainy. Sadly, the man's fighting skills are not as immense as his bravery, and he goes down to Yen Chan Ying like so many others before him.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de la emboscada, Mauricio se siente traicionado y quiere venganza. Aurelio, Mónica y Lay llegan a México. Santiago viaja a solas con Ximena y le propone matrimonio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Tras acusarla de darle pistas falsas sobre Aurelio, el Chema le pide a Matilde información sobre Chacorta. Leonor quiere que Victoria la ayude a encontrar a Ximena.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema amenaza a Mónica para que lo ponga en contacto con Francisco, sin saber que hablan del propio Aurelio. Ella le revela que está embarazada para que dejen de golpearla.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio denuncia al Chema con la Interpol, en un intento desesperado por rescatar a Mónica. Leonor comienza a seguir a Ximena, mientras Ignacio y Victoria le ayudan a conseguir información.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Después de una balacera con agentes de Interpol, la DEA captura al Chema, quien intenta sobornarlos. Santiago le sugiere que Heriberto se entregue para proteger a Ximena.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Leonor le exige a Ximena que entregue a Aurelio y, a cambio, le propone dejar en paz a Heriberto. Lay busca asociarse con Iñaqui para operar el tráfico de drogas.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema le pide a Andrews que vigile a Elsa porque ella es pieza clave para su huida de la cárcel. Leonor sigue a Ximena y descubre nuevas pistas que la sorprenden.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le pide a Lay que consiga pasaportes españoles para él, Mónica y Heriberto porque necesitan huir. Mónica tiene miedo de perder a su bebé y pide que la lleven a un hospital.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema manda a Tijeras y Tostado a cumplir su amenaza contra el hijo de Chacorta. Víctor recibe un disparo en cada pierna. Doña Alba le reclama a Aurelio por el dolor que sufre la familia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victor culpa a su padre y su tío de la desgracia que está viviendo, y le dice a Chacorta que ellos solo siembran muerte y destrucción en la familia. Mónica está desconsolada tras perder al bebé.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica le dice a Aurelio que está embarazada, y él quiere construir un laboratorio en territorio venezolano. Chacorta hace una oferta de negocio a Pepe Johnson para vender cocaína por su cuenta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto quiere vengarse de Ignacio. Chema busca la ayuda de Elsa para conseguir que Tijeras salga de la cárcel. Heriberto toma una decisión que cambia su vida: dejar el negocio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Lay confiesa su eterno amor por Aurelio, viaja a Colombia y pone en riesgo su vida para verlo. En un intento desesperado por no ser deportada, Leonor acepta casarse con Ignacio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mónica está lista para matar a Lay: Ella revela que fue Tijeras quien orquestó el ataque, y deben escapar juntas. Ximena cubre a Heriberto cuando Chacorta llega a la casa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerra entre bandas del narcotráfico apenas comienza. Aurelio promete venganza: sugiere a Chacorta que trasladen el negocio a España y vigilen a Chema, quien podría escapar de prisión.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Pantaleón es secuestrado por Tostado y Tijeras, quienes lo torturan. Aurelio retoma sus negocios con el general Montoya, cambia de planes y viaja a Colombia para comenzar su venganza.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Chacorta que mató al Tostado, y aunque vengó a Víctor, aún no ha terminado. Anuncia nuevos negocios con Venezuela y dice que comenzará a llamarse Danilo Ferro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa tiene que ceder para ayudar al Chema a escapar de prisión. Leonor tiene secretos insospechados, y planea usar a Ximena de carnada para atrapar a líderes del narcotráfico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roberto reclama que los Casillas lo usan para lavar dinero del narco y quiere salirse, pero ya es muy tarde. Leonor y Nevárez visitan al Chema en prisión y lo vinculan con Elsa.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se encuentra cara a cara con Danilo Ferro y comienza a usar su identidad. Leonor registra el negocio de Matilde y hace que la arresten por todo el material importante que encuentra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Bigotes le dispara a Nevárez frente a su hija. Agonizando, Pedro ruega a Victoria que deje México, porque ya el país es muy peligroso. Matilde conoce a Elsa, y ambas son manipuladas por el Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Elsa cree tener el camino libre para ser gobernadora, pero Victoria anuncia su candidatura. Bigotes está herido, escapa de los hombres de Chema e intenta darle toda la información a Leonor.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Doña Alba sugiere a Matilde que visite al padre Lázaro en busca de ayuda espiritual, pero ella confiesa que Aurelio está vivo. Tijeras rechaza volver a la cárcel para ayudar a escapar a Chema.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Victoria recibe una carta seductora y se ilusiona, sin saber que detrás está Aurelio, quien le dona 5 millones de pesos a nombre de Danilo. Matilde promete a Guernica delatar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Chema escapa de la cárcel con ayuda de Tijeras. Sin saberlo, Elsa firma los papeles que garantizan la fuga. Ella y Victoria siguen adelante con sus campañas por el Gobierno de Jalisco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El padre Lázaro no puede con la presión: quiere hablar con el obispo. Ernesto le pide a Chacorta que le dé un susto. Finalmente, en la casa de Danilo, Victoria y Aurelio se conocen.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los hombres de Chacorta descubren que el padre Lázaro iba a hablar con Garnica, y lo silencian; no dejan cabos sueltos. Por recuperar a su hijo, Matilde está decidida a entregar a Chacorta.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: A Matilde le tortura la idea de no volver a ver a su hijo, y el Chema le sugiere que lo secuestre. Leonor desconfía del suicidio del padre Lázaro: le pide a Garnica que presione a los Casillas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Demanda a la mamá de la niña que, con el palo de una piñata, dejó a su hija sin dientes. Vanessa y Verónica quieren desalojar a Marta, su madre, por imponer severas reglas a los niños.
programme.sub-title: Cindi y la piñata; La jefa

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Victoria exige que la mujer de su exesposo le pague lo que le prestó, ella alega que vive en su casa gratis. Gustavo pide el divorcio, su mujer lo acusa de matar a la hija por la herencia.
programme.sub-title: Pegado a su ex; Desaparecida por la herencia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Enyer le pide a su tío que cumpla el contrato que firmaron, él se niega porque no cuidó de su hijo. Angélica quiere abortar, cree que tiene al diablo en la barriga, su esposo busca internarla.
programme.sub-title: ¿Quién tiene la culpa?; La ecografía del diablo

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un dúo de músicos urbanos denuncia que su productor los controla con un reloj que no pueden quitarse. Adrián cumple su deseo de vestirse y actuar como niña, su esposa le pide el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian le exige a su madre el dinero que su padre dejó para sus estudios, pero ese fondo ya no existe. En otro caso, Armando y su profesora bailan tango con mucha pasión y Jenny se molesta.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: A Camila la van a deportar por culpa de su exjefe Raúl, quien la envió en busca de mercancía y de un amigo ilegal. Mariana demanda a una periodista por informar que había defraudado al gobierno.
programme.sub-title: Viaje en deportación; A la luz pública

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luis responsabiliza a Ricardo del suicidio de su hija, lo acusa de prostituirla en Las Vegas. Marta va a prisión por drogas y sus hijos se quedan con su hermana, quien no le permite verlos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Katiuska exige que su madrastra pague sus deudas médicas, por su culpa ella perdió su embarazo. María Alejandra acusa a su esposo de usarla como moneda de cambio en una deuda, la violaron.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Efraín demanda a su padre por introducir dos colmillos de león en su maleta para pasarlos por la aduana. La mujer de Pedro se suicida en casa de Lourdes, él cree que ella la incitó.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos hermanos no se soportan y sus padres no saben cómo resolverlo. Sufre de una rara enfermedad, toma bebidas energéticas para no quedarse dormido, ahora no puede conciliar el sueño.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Un bebé muere por un "slime" que hicieron sus hermanos mientras estaban con su madrastra. Pide una canción biográfica para su matrimonio, el resultado es tan desastroso que se cancela la boda.
programme.sub-title: Slime; La canción de la desgracia

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Contagia de hepatitis A a su yerno y a un amigo, pero no a los nietos. Alina pierde su bote tras ponerlo como colateral de la fianza del hermano de su nuera Fary, ahora quiere que se lo pague.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El esposo de Jenny se ha convertido en un narcisista que solo aprecia su propia belleza. Por proteger la calidad de sus plantas de marihuana, elimina una gran cantidad de abejas del vecino.
programme.sub-title: El narcicista; Un instruso no deseado

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La obesidad ayuda a José a luchar contra la eyaculación precoz, pero afecta su salud. Una madre pierde la custodia de sus hijos, porque su esposo hace peligrosos videos de bromas con ellos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Adrián demanda al amante de su esposa por haber destruido deliberadamente su matrimonio. Juan está obsesionado con una muñeca inflable con apariencia de niña, su esposa está asustada.
programme.sub-title: El amante bandido; Muñeca menor de edad

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Brendan quiere abortar, pues el feto afecta su proceso de transformación, pero su pareja no está de acuerdo. Por enfermedad, convierte a su hija en su cuidadora, una responsabilidad de adultos.
programme.sub-title: Mi mujer me embarazó; La chef

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alexander está hundido en la depresión, su amiga y terapeuta le decide aplicarle un tratamiento de choque y él piensa que morirá. Valentín demanda a Débora por arrancarle un testículo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Stephany se graba desnuda para su canal de recetas veganas, pero su esposo distribuye el material en una web porno. Ramón usa su gallo como apoyo sexual, su vecino no soporta el canto del ave.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Seguramente se introduce en la casa de su familia verdadera y ahora la reclama como suya. Se hizo un anillo de compromiso con las cenizas de su padre, su madre se niega a que su esposo esté ahí.
programme.sub-title: Hija perdida; No es un polvo, es un diamante

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La doctora Ana María Polo interviene en batallas legales que afectan a los latinos. Como en una corte, las partes presentan testigos y evidencias para que ella emita su decisión. Además, expertos contribuyen con sus conocimientos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La esposa de Fabio muere durante un paseo en el bote de Edi, ella dejó un seguro de vida a nombre del anfitrión. Tiene que abortar por el ataque de un felino y decide demandar a su condominio.
programme.sub-title: Bote de la muerte; El gato montés

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pide empleo en un restaurante donde solo trabajan chicas, considera que fomentan la discriminación. Susana le exige que Mario vaya a terapia para que supere su adicción a los videojuegos.
programme.sub-title: Problema de falda; Adicto al play

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Dos modelos se pelean porque una de ellas ganó el "casting", después de hacerle una jugada sucia a la otra y provocar su traslado al hospital. Demanda al arrendatario por vivir con una loca.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere que su esposa embarazada deje de comer pollo porque afecta el tamaño del pene del bebé. Tuvieron un encuentro sexual con su pareja de inquilinos, ella quiere repetir y él que se marchen.
programme.sub-title: El problema eres tú; El inquilino

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su marido no solo abusa de ella, sino que además, es el asesino de su anterior esposa. Una "baby-sitter" tiene un incidente en la casa donde cuida de una niña, pero quien muere es su propia hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Asegura que su anciana hermana murió por la excitación sexual que experimentó con dos strippers. Le dan poco presupuesto para una publicidad musical y el resultado es una auténtica basura.
programme.sub-title: Muerta de alegría; Música para mis oídos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Katherine busca desalojar a la suegra por los experimentos que hace. Los padres dejaron que la menor embarazada se case, ella queda emancipada para algunas cosas, pero no para otras.
programme.sub-title: El homúnculo; La niña y el abusador

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natacha queda como la única heredera de su papá, pero su media hermana Claudia tiene otro testamento. Por otro lado, una familia contacta a la receptora del corazón que donó su hijo fallecido.
programme.sub-title: Mi hermana es una asesina; De corazón

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pierde su brazo y ahora enfrenta un grave problema, no puede ejercer su profesión. Descubre que su pareja tenía otra familia y toma represalias, ahora le exigen el pago de los gastos médicos.
programme.sub-title: La vida es bella; La culpa es tuya

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Quiere desalojarlos por conflictivos, ellos creen que los discrimina. Mirela llega a un acuerdo con José para quedarse con la pensión de su padre, pero el plan se cae cuando aparece la viuda.
programme.sub-title: Odio y desalojo; The Gold Digger

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su esposo es el ladrón y ella quiere la recompensa que ofrecen por su captura. Marina se entera de que un cura demostró que es su padre y obtuvo su custodia, quiera llevársela a Panamá.
programme.sub-title: La recompensa; Bendita sea mi padre

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Johnny sufre un accidente tras enterarse de que uno de sus hijos no es suyo. Simón y Dolores están en pleno acto sexual, cuando el esposo de ella los sorprende, le mutila el miembro al amante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anthony exige que su hermano Edgard le pague por haberlo violado. Una madre se niega a entregarle dinero a su hijo para sus estudios, ella alega que no escogió una carrera profesional.
programme.sub-title: Hermano abusa a hermano; Universidad de influencers

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Liz y Joan tienen una hija albina, a quien le afecta vivir en Miami por su condición, la madre quiere irse del país. Bárbara exige que Rafael y Albert paguen por robarle sus clientes.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Verónica siente que su hermana la estafó emocionalmente, incitándola a enamorarse de una amiga con quien tenía un acuerdo de sacarle todo el dinero posible. La hermana alega que nada fue premeditado. Benjamín odia a las iguanas y a los indocumentados. El estado de Florida permite dispararle a las iguanas con rifles de balines y él, alegando que le estaba disparando a una iguana, le pegó un tiro en un ojo a Iván, quién, casualmente, es indocumentado.
programme.sub-title: Duplo golpe emocional; Balines contra iguanas

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Joan tiene la custodia total de su hija y Yuri descubre que la niña hace videos de "autobullying". En otro caso, la serpiente de Ángel y Rose se come al lindo perro de su vecina Katiana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El novio de Laura le cuidaba la mascota, el animal ingiere cocaína y aparece muerto. Andrés le practica sexo oral a su mujer durante la menstruación, le causa lesiones físicas y psicológicas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Luz América intenta ir al funeral de su hija, pero su hermana y su madre lo impiden. Yarelis cuida a su hijo de 18 años como si fuera un bebé, el padre quiere que el chico se vaya de la casa.
programme.sub-title: Si te fuiste, a qué has vuelto; Mama's Boy

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard speaks with several independent researchers about their allegations that a powerful, secretive cabal of international bankers is attempting to rule the course of history and imprison humanity through their monopoly of the creation and control of the planet's money supply.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard interviews an investigative health reporter and a NY Times best-selling author about their claims regarding depopulation. programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: According to a poll conducted by The Roper Organization in 1992, 3.7 million Americans could have been alien abductees. programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: The United Nations claims the significance of Agenda 21 is for sustainable development, but there is speculation it may be to control inventory and the use of all the world's resources. Richard will speak with a U.N. official in search of the truth.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to Mississippi to interview an expedition organizer who plans to lead a team to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world. programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: These attacks are the most terrifying part of the phenomenon, and therefore, the most real. What is behind these aggressive apparitions?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: There is a battle going on for your mind. From the Cold War to the TV set, someone wants to control what you think, how you act and what you believe. We'll reveal the new practices in mind control and tell you why you need to start paying attention before it's too late.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Since the dawn of man, the few have tried to control the fate of the many. But is there really an elite group of powerbrokers trying to rule the planet? And if so, who is behind this New World Order?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: It seems the world is fascinated with all things science fiction. First it was vampires, then werewolves, and now Zombies. But could this once seemingly far fetched idea be closer to happening then we ever thought possible? Are zombies becoming a reality?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: New developments in science and research have invented equipment that may have much more sinister capabilities than we are being led to believe. Are governments around the world using weather control to incite the next World War and possibly destroy the planet?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The past few decades have been filled with stunning technological advancement. But is all this 'progress' good for humanity? Animal cloning has been a reality for decades but the disturbing experiments going on behind close doors will shock you. Human cloning may be much closer than you think.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There is physical evidence of alien activity that has been hidden from the public for years. It is starting to be revealed.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: It is likely that aliens exist in a universe as large as ours. How would they navigate those vast distances and potentially visit us on earth?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: There are three types of close encounters, sightings, fleeting interactions, aliens taking humans for extended periods. We meet real people who have experienced alien life up close.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: An entire family takes up arms in a rooftop showdown with the Spottsville Monster, a vicious beast with a taste for flesh. Eerie Phantoms protect survivors of one of America's most deadly tornadoes and New Jersey fishermen face off with a gigantic bug.
programme.sub-title: Spottsville Monster, Mantis Man, and Tornado Phantoms

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: A towering nocturnal monster and an owl witch relentlessly stalk the young and innocent. Sightings of a wild man beast plunged a town into panic and may even have launched a secret government search. --- The Rake, Lechuza, and Sykesville Monster.

programme.title: Monsters and Mysteries
programme.desc: A vicious hairy beast, a giant winged creature, and shadow monsters terrify their witnesses - even plunging entire towns into panic and fear. Midwestern residents recount stories of MOMO, The Van Meter Visitor, and Shadow People.
programme.sub-title: Momo, Shadow People, Van Meter Visitor

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Certain structures on our planet have stood the test of time and continue to astonish mankind. So much so, that alien intervention in their construction thousands of years ago, has yet to be ruled out.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Mars is the key focus of humanity's expansion into space right now. Millions of years ago the Red Planet had a lot in common with Earth, but it's now a desert wasteland. Do the doorways recently discovered on the planet's surface lead to an existential lesson for our species?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Some places in the world, record more UAP sightings than the rest. So many so, in fact, that people flock from all over the world just for the chance to glimpse a flying saucer.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: As the Fermi Paradox states, the possibilities that there is advanced life in the universe is surprisingly high. And if the universe is so old, why haven't we had any contact with extraterrestrial life?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: UAPs have only recently been witnessed entering the ocean at very high speeds. And since our oceans can be as much as six miles deep, is it possible that some of these UAPs were simply trying to get home?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Millions of people believe extraterrestrial live on Earth. Are the aliens here to enlighten us or destroy us? What if the worst-case scenario happened? What would aliens do? And how would they do it?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: They're our first line of defense in the darkest of times. And they're often the first responders to threats from another world. Over the past 70 years the world's military forces have come face to face with thousands of UFOs.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Every day, millions take to the sky in commercial flights all over the world. But decades of evidence have revealed we may not be the world's only frequent flyers. Are we in danger of losing control of our skies to extraterrestrial beings?

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: It's the stuff of nightmares. Emergency lines flooded with calls as UFOs appear in the sky. Mounting evidence has revealed that UFO waves are able to penetrate the world's most closely guarded airspace.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: It's the ultimate close encounter. There have been thousands of reported cases all over the world. But these claims are almost invariably dismissed by authorities with little or no investigation.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: Nations all over the world are rumored to have recovered metal debris from these UFO crashes. From self-healing hulls to sinister alien implants, join is as the secrets of UFO metals are UNSEALED.

programme.title: Unsealed Alien Files
programme.desc: The flying saucer. For decades it's been synonymous with UFO terror. But millions of reported encounters tell a very different story. From Cold War showdowns to telepathic terrors, join is as we track the rise of Black Triangles.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: The Ghost Dimension team head to Shipley, West Yorkshire to investigate The Old Glen House Pub.' With a catalogue of reported paranormal activity will the team witness the apparition who has been seen loitering around the fireplace? Will one team member be able to face the corridor alone where many a ghostly encounter has been had by staff and customers alike?
programme.sub-title: The Old Glen and Milner Curse

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Lockdown
programme.desc: Ghost Dimension investigate claims of a ghost lady in grey haunting Windleshaw Abbey, St. Helens, Merseyside. Over 600 years old and with new paranormal encounters reported almost weekly at the location. Bex and Sean each take expert ghost hunting equipment along and attempt to make contact with the infamous lady in grey.

programme.title: Ghost Dimension Flying Solo
programme.desc: Sean heads to Rochdale and investigates strange paranormal reports at Owd Betts. Something spooky lurks in the basement and it seems Sean is not alone as he investigates the main bar. With so many sightings of ghostly spirits at the pub, will they join the investigation tonight?

programme.title: Ghost Dimension
programme.desc: Bex and Sean head into Northwich, Cheshire to investigate a disused bingo hall. Bex braves a loan vigil, which she will never forget as a door seemingly opens on its own, objects are moved and a spirit takes a seat with Sean on his investigation. Are the spirits still waiting for their final numbers to be called?
programme.sub-title: Full House at Northwich Plaza and Bingo Hall

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: On December 28, 1980, the Rendlesham Incident became a legendary mystery, as US Air Force soldiers recorded witness accounts of mysterious lights appearing in the skies of Suffolk, England.

programme.title: Paranormal Files: Extraordinary Stories - Ordinary People
programme.desc: For decades, Kent's Blue Bell Hill has been the site of mysterious phenomena. Rumored ghost sightings have haunted the pastoral site. Explore the haunting legacy of Blue Bell Hill in this episode.
programme.sub-title: The Mystery of Blue Bell Hill

programme.title: On the Yeti Trail
programme.desc: Does the Yeti really exist? Our film sets out to meet the teams involved in this strange race across the world, and features laboratories, hair analysis, footprints and DNA as well as the search for samples in Indonesia and in Canadian nature reserves. A fascinating and thorough film, featuring, amongst others, French Collège de France paleoanthropologist Pascal Picq.

programme.title: World's Greatest Mysteries
programme.desc: Bigfoot. Sasquatch. Yeti. Yeren.Yowie. There are reports the world over of these terrifying creatures. This program shows a chilling eyewitness encounter plus scientific analysis of the creature's footprints providing startling insights into this mystery.
programme.sub-title: Bigfoot: Living Creature or Legendary Lie?

programme.title: The Other Side: Secrets of the Paranormal World
programme.desc: Continuation of Exorcism but this time in Italy with Father Dermine, a Roman Catholic Exorcist. Discussion with Derren Brown and Matteo Borrini. Introduction to Simulation Theory and Psychics. Controlled Experiments and discussion with Derren Brown, Uri Geller and Peter Sage. A discussion between believer and non-believer.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: In this re-examination of the assassination of civil rights leader Martin Luther King, Richard talks to various researchers who offer evidence that, James Earl Ray, was not the real triggerman. The researchers claim the plot was arranged by the highest levels of government and law enforcement. A noted debunker in the skeptic community refutes these claims as inaccurate.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard speaks with several explorers and cryptozoologists who believe pterodactyls, flying dinosaurs thought to have become extinct some 60 million years ago, are still alive. They are believed to be thriving in remote places such as Papua New Guinea.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard speaks with victims of alleged electronic harassment, the supposed use of electronic devices to harass, torture, and/or physically harm a person. Some victims allege that the government is behind it. Richard also speaks with a private investigator who specializes in electronic counter measures and a social psychologist who dismisses such claims as fantasy and paranoia.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard investigates the practice of past-life regression therapy, a technique where subjects are placed under hypnosis in order to recover what practitioners believe are memories of past lives. A young woman relives a previous life in the American South during the 19th Century. There she experiences a profound loss which helps explain a current life problem; a fear of having children.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show with Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard travels to New Mexico and Arizona to speak with the pre-eminent investigators of the alleged crash of a UFO near Roswell, New Mexico in July 1947. These researchers have investigated first hand accounts, even death bed testimonials from many of the eye-witnesses to the incident, affirming the existence of such a craft, the ensuing government cover-up and the recovery of alien bodies.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: Since the beginning of time man has expressed his religious beliefs through rock art, it gives the feeling that he has worshipped some mysterious gods, that generally came from the stars. Over the millennia, these gods have changed in shape and name, but the way they have been disguised in our beliefs remains the same, in many cases to the misfortune of the witnesses.

programme.title: EXtraterrestrials: They are Among Us
programme.desc: From Mafasca, in the plains of Fuerteventura, to Pardal, in the mountains of Albacete, passing through the light of Cayón in Cantabria, we are talking about intelligent luminosities. These are seen at night and have even followed witnesses. They are the most commonly seen lights, undoubtedly a phenomenon that is part of another of the strangest aspects of the UFO theme: The foo- fighters.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: The Great Deceiver. Seducer of the masses. The Bringer of Armageddon. Every culture and religion on the planet believes that an evil one will usher in the end of days. But who is this Anti-Christ? And how can we hope to stop him?

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: We rely on machines for virtually every aspect of modern life. Have we reached the point where we need them more than they need us? If technology goes too far, too fast, there may be a time where we are no longer at the top of the evolutionary food chain.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Scientists believe that Stargates are doorways to wormholes in time. As it turns out, the government may have already known that. We'll reveal the secret location of stargates around the world and tell you who is trying to open them and why.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files counts down the top 10 conspiracies of all time: (10) the moon landing hoax, (9) MK Ultra mind control experiments, (8) the secret Area 51 air force base, (7) the H.A.A.R.P. antenna installation, (6) Chemtrails in the atmosphere, (5) the New World Order, (4) the Jesus was married conspiracy, (3) the Roswell incident, (2) Hitler's Death, and (1) the JFK assassination.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at how the Soviet Union and the United States sponsored experiments in remote viewing during the Cold War. It also looks at how the CIA spent $20 million dollars investigating remote viewing as a part of Project Stargate. It also discusses how remote viewers were used to look for the Mars Observer and a possible Mars Base.

programme.title: Unsealed Conspiracy Files
programme.desc: Unsealed: Conspiracy Files looks at how some world leaders throughout history have used impostors and doubles. It considers theories whether Osama bin Laden had a double, Elizabeth I died in her youth and was replaced by a boy, George Washington was replaced by the head of the Illuminati Adam Weishaupt, and that Hitler faked his suicide and fled to Argentina.

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: From military radar to Navy aircraft, sightings of Unidentified Aerial Phenomena have become more frequent of late and been measured on ever more sophisticated technology. It has lead to unprecedented acceptance of alien contact across the globe, including by the US government. What could these visitors be after? Is it the potential energy stored in the Earth's oceans?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: Several US presidents throughout history have described encounters with UAPs. Is there already an agreement in place between our world leaders and intelligent alien life? And if so, who is keeping that information from the public and why?

programme.title: Alien Disclosure Files
programme.desc: In 1998 Astronauts captured images of a satellite in Earth's orbit. Is it the same alien object that Nicola Tesla detected in 1899, an alien probe known as the Black Knight?
